question: Which Indian archer became the first to win a gold medal at the 2024 Paralympic Games?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Harvinder Sing__h**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Harvinder Singh made history at the Paris Paralympic Games 2024 by becoming the first Indian archer to win a gold medal in archery.
 
• He competed in the Men’s Recurve Open category.
 
• In the final match, he defeated his opponent and secured the gold medal for India.
 
• Earlier, he had won a bronze medal at the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics, but at Paris 2024, he created history by winning the gold medal.

*Hence, statement is correct.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sheetal Devi:**

 
 
• **Sheetal Devi** is a para-archer from **India** who competes in the compound archery category. Her success at the **2024 Paralympic Games** marks a significant milestone in her career.
 
• She has also excelled in various international competitions, establishing herself as one of the top para-athletes in the field of archery.
 
 
 
• **Archery at the Paralympic Games:**
 
 
• **Archery** at the Paralympic Games includes both recurve and compound categories. The compound category involves using advanced bows equipped with pulleys and magnifying scopes for enhanced precision.
 
• Para archery is adapted for athletes with disabilities, and the competition format is similar to the Olympic Games, with individual and team events.
 
 
 
• **India’s Para Sports Achievements:**
 
 
• India has been increasingly focusing on **para sports**, with efforts to provide better facilities, coaching, and training programs for athletes with disabilities.
 
• Initiatives such as the **Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)** have played a crucial role in supporting para-athletes financially and professionally.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Challenges faced by para-athletes:**

 
 
• **Accessibility issues:** Para-athletes often face challenges regarding access to appropriate training facilities and equipment.
 
• **Financial constraints:** Despite government initiatives, funding remains a significant issue for many para-athletes.
 
 
 
• **Government support:**
 
 
• The **Indian government** has introduced schemes like **TOPS** and launched programs to encourage the participation of para-athletes in international competitions.
 
• These efforts have resulted in consistent success at events like the Paralympic Games, Asian Para Games, and World Para Championships.
